history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

The 3-bedroom option is Type A: 900 sq ft, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen are open-plan, with an entrance foyer and a small storage area; there’s no long internal corridor, so less of the floor area is taken up by circulation. Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft inclusive of sinking fund, which works out to about RM162 a month for 900 sq ft. That’s the maintenance component only; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use, and any loan instalment depends on the unit price and financing. I’ll get the current indicative Type A price for a clearer monthly picture. If the layout sounds promising, I’d be happy to help arrange a viewing so you can assess the space in person.

The layout sounds like it could suit us, and we’re hoping to buy for our own stay. Could you check the current Type A price and any other regular charges? We’re aiming to keep the purchase around RM450,000, so I’d like to understand the costs before deciding about a viewing.

For a rough guide, the price reference I can see lists Type A base prices around RM328,000–RM358,000, depending on floor and facing. That isn’t a confirmed current quote: a unit-specific car-park premium may apply, and the current package depends on the exact unit. So I can’t yet confirm the final price against your RM450,000 target. The only recurring charge verified so far is maintenance at about RM162/month, including sinking fund; clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use. I don’t have verified details of any other regular charges. The current Type A price and charge check is still pending, so I’ll share the confirmed figures before you decide whether a viewing makes sense.
